newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Citybus seen in HK$355 mln IPO - sources.
newsitem.headline: HK's Citybus seen in HK$355 mln IPO - sources.

text.p: Citybus Group Ltd, a spinoff bus operator of CNT Group Ltd, is expected to raise HK$355 million through an initial public offering (IPO) of 250 million shares at HK$1.42 per share, market sources said on Friday.
Its IPO is expected to begin in Hong Kong in mid-November, with dealing in the shares expected to begin on November 29, sources said.
Last week, CNT Group announced plans to seek a separate listing for its unit Citybus by issuing 250 million new shares, or about 25 percent of Citybus' enlarged share capital.
CNT had said Citybus would make a preferential offer to CNT shareholders on the basis of one Citybus share for every 10 CNT shares held.
HSBC Investment is the advisor on the listing.
